title: Mutuality moves through an ending form

captions.physics: Ending an earlier way of participating

meaning: Ending an earlier form through a wish for mutuality is emotionally accompanied by the experience of events taking different turns.
text: Death in the physical position of this Energy Field describes shared actions that end an earlier form or phase. The Lovers in energy give a motive to seek living mutual involvement and remain turned towards each other. The Wheel of Fortune in emotions adds a sense of changing circumstances. The overall tone may therefore be mobile: you finish a particular way of participating because you want an actual response, while emotionally moving through turns that the wish for closeness cannot make predictable in advance.

For example, you finish running a shared channel about walks so that you can spend more time together without compulsory filming. The final materials are uploaded and the schedule removed. A free weekend initially brings pleasure, then its unfamiliar emptiness disappoints, and a spontaneous walk restores interest. **We ended the earlier form for involvement in each other, while the response continues to change.** This alternation cancels neither the sincerity of the original wish nor the validity of considering the ending. Different feelings can accompany the same practical decision.

A difficulty arises if living mutuality is measured by an unchanging pleasant feeling. Every disappointment becomes a sign that you should not have finished, prompting a hurried return. The Wheel in emotions guarantees no even response, and the Lovers as motivation require no identical feeling at every moment. Death concerns a particular practice ending, rather than establishing a compulsory new script for the two people’s future life.
